lifecycle.rule: Events contain only stable localized message/action keys, opaque IDs, validated final text and opaque source handles. Raw model tokens, prompts, evidence excerpts, source citation IDs, paths, hashes, timings and exceptions never enter the event stream.

bounds.cancellation: Stop and disconnect set cancellation before invoking the existing worker process-group cancellation. The controller emits exactly one incomplete terminal cancellation event; a later worker outcome cannot replace it with an answer.
bounds.timeout: Timeout invokes the same cancellation boundary and emits exactly one incomplete assistant_timeout error. The active slot is not released until the stopped worker returns, so no concurrent replacement worker can start.
bounds.backpressure: Events are an in-memory bounded deque. Slow or disconnected consumers cause stale nonterminal events to be discarded; they never block inference or create unbounded jobs.

source_handles: Only validated final-answer citations receive fresh opaque source handles. A handle maps to one completed in-memory request and never reveals the evidence citation ID, path, chunk, vector or score.
